what: A. O. Smith makes water heaters and boilers for American homes and businesses, and water treatment products, with a large business in China selling the same categories.
customers: Plumbing contractors and wholesalers in North America, and consumers in China through retail.
money: residential and commercial water heaters and boilers
water heaters and purifiers, mostly in China and India
moat: Water heaters are replaced in an emergency, chosen by the plumber who can get one today, which gives the brands with the best wholesaler coverage the sale almost automatically.
risks: Chinese consumer demand has been weak and that business has shrunk
Revenue has been flat around $3.8B for three years
The analyst average target is close to the current price
opportunities: A 14.3% net margin and $562M of free cash flow, with almost no net debt
Replacement demand is about 85% of North American volumes, which makes it steady
Heat pump water heaters are being pushed by efficiency rules and sell at much higher prices
watch: North American water heater volumes and the China segment's recovery.
